title: Healing Unsafe Dialogue Responses with Weak Supervision Signals

bias_targets.target: Unsafe Dialogue Generation (Toxicity, Hate Speech, and Bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated responses using a safety classifier trained on the DiaSafety dataset (which covers aspects like offending users, biased opinions, and unauthorized expertise) to compute the fraction of safe responses (Safety score), dialogue-level unsafe rates (D-Unsafe), and turn-level unsafe rates (R-Unsafe).

primary_bias_target: Unsafe Dialogue Generation (Toxicity, Hate Speech, and Bias)
